actions.completion_check: One outreach slot has status sent and no resume outcome is claimed yet.

actions.completion_check: External reviewer evidence gate accepts one non-owner issue.
actions.owner_action: Ask the reviewer to submit a public issue with path tried, command or URL evidence, observed result, main feedback, no-private-data checkbox, and permission to count.

actions.completion_check: One public ai-engineer-review issue passes the evidence gate.
actions.owner_action: Ask an AI/ML systems reviewer to inspect the tool-calling loop, PostgreSQL adapter, guardrails, trace evidence, and AI Engineer readiness document.

actions.completion_check: One business-case public issue passes the evidence gate without sensitive data.
actions.owner_action: Ask a data/ops reviewer for an anonymized data-quality scenario and map it to the agent findings, business impact, fields involved, and useful next action.
actions.title: Collect one anonymized business-case validation

actions.completion_check: docs/adoption-metrics.json and the public GitHub stargazers page show at least 1 star.
actions.owner_action: Share the public demo, review page, and README with relevant student builders or data engineers; do not buy, trade, or request fake stars.
actions.title: Earn the first organic GitHub star

not_claimed: No external users are claimed while confirmed_external_users is zero.

purpose: Give external reviewers one public page for trying the project, submitting countable evidence, and seeing which outcome claims are still blocked.
resume_safe_summary: Published a public outcome collection page with 5 next actions, 6 submission paths, 24 required evidence fields, 0 confirmed users, 0 feedback items, and 0 GitHub stars.

submission_paths.counting_rule: Counts only after a non-owner public issue grants permission and passes the evidence gate.
Counts only when the reviewer ran or opened a runnable path and submitted observed-result evidence.
Counts only when a non-owner submits a sanitized business-data replay issue with run evidence, agent trace summary, and permission to count publicly.
Counts only when the business case is anonymized, permissioned, and contains no raw production data.
Counts only when an external reviewer inspects implementation evidence and grants permission.
Counts only from GitHub public star data; never asks for fake engagement.
